Authorities competent to issue 'NOC'.Decision to grant 'NOC' to be taken at the level of an Officer not below the rank of Director/Joint Secretary to Government or equivalent, or Head of Office though he may be of lower rank. An Officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government or equivalent to be authorized to sign the 'NOC'.Chapter 71.
